## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The failure-report selector should match `./`-prefixed paths against normalized requests so selected failures are included in reruns.

## Changes

The pull request adds a failure-report selector, simplifies cached selection, and adds tests for explicit, cached, and failure-report selection.

## Important

- app/selection.py:20 — correctness — Normalize failure paths when matching requests — A report containing `./tests/test_x.py` returns `[]` when the request names `tests/test_x.py`. The new selector compares the raw path, while both existing selectors normalize it before matching. — A requested failed test is skipped on rerun when the report gives its path a `./` prefix. — Fix: Reuse `select_explicit` to match normalized paths while preserving the report’s spelling.
